fields.q: 望着云朵总能抚慰我受伤的心。你愿意陪我一起看吗？
fields.en: Looking at the clouds always is a balm for my hurt and heart. Would you join me, looking?
fields.name: 妮涅

q.value: 望着云朵总能抚慰我受伤的心。你愿意陪我一起看吗？

en.value: Looking at the clouds always is a balm for my hurt and heart. Would you join me, looking?

fields.q: 我一看向别人，他们就移开视线。看来我永远都被人畏惧。
fields.en: When I look at someone, they in turn look away. It seems that I'm forever feared.
fields.name: 妮涅

q.value: 我一看向别人，他们就移开视线。看来我永远都被人畏惧。

en.value: When I look at someone, they in turn look away. It seems that I'm forever feared.

fields.en: I like being alone in my solitude. Do you too?
fields.name: 妮涅

en.value: I like being alone in my solitude. Do you too?

fields.q: 精灵们想和你说话。它们……对你很好奇。
fields.en: The spirits want to talk to you. They're… curious about you.
fields.name: 妮涅

q.value: 精灵们想和你说话。它们……对你很好奇。

en.value: The spirits want to talk to you. They're… curious about you.

fields.q: 是啊，真的……很有趣呢……咦，你看不见我在和谁说话吗？
fields.en: Yes, truly… It is wonderful fun, isn't it… What, can't you see who I'm speaking with?
fields.name: 妮涅

q.value: 是啊，真的……很有趣呢……咦，你看不见我在和谁说话吗？

en.value: Yes, truly… It is wonderful fun, isn't it… What, can't you see who I'm speaking with?

fields.q: 我非常讨厌虫子。有虫子靠近我的话，你能帮我赶走吗？
fields.en: I have a strong dislike for insects. Could you chase off any who draw too close to me?
fields.name: 妮涅

q.value: 我非常讨厌虫子。有虫子靠近我的话，你能帮我赶走吗？

en.value: I have a strong dislike for insects. Could you chase off any who draw too close to me?

fields.q: 我的话似乎总会被人听成奇怪的意思。我被误解……又被疏远。
fields.en: I fear that my words enter the ear in strange ways. I am misunderstood… and avoided.
fields.name: 妮涅

q.value: 我的话似乎总会被人听成奇怪的意思。我被误解……又被疏远。

en.value: I fear that my words enter the ear in strange ways. I am misunderstood… and avoided.

fields.q: 死亡萦绕着我。你也被死亡萦绕吗？
fields.en: Death haunts me. Are you haunted by death?
fields.name: 妮涅

q.value: 死亡萦绕着我。你也被死亡萦绕吗？

en.value: Death haunts me. Are you haunted by death?

fields.q: 若你愿意和我一起祈祷，让迷途的灵魂前往彼岸，我会很感激。
fields.en: I would be grateful if you would pray with me, that wayward souls may move on to the next world.
fields.name: 妮涅

q.value: 若你愿意和我一起祈祷，让迷途的灵魂前往彼岸，我会很感激。

en.value: I would be grateful if you would pray with me, that wayward souls may move on to the next world.
